data.one_liner: Style your terminal strings with an expressive and chained API.
data.what_it_does: Chalk provides a way to style and color terminal output in Dart and Flutter applications. It features an expressive API that allows chaining styles, nesting formats, and specifying text colors and font faces.
use_when: You want to color and format terminal text in CLI tools or server-side Dart apps.
You need to nest multiple styles like bold and colors together for console output.
avoid_when: You are building a graphical user interface (GUI) or Flutter widget tree.
You need complex terminal UI components beyond basic string styling.
weaknesses: Certain formatting options like underline and strike-through are not widely supported

alternatives.name: console
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides console output styling and helper functions for Dart terminal applications.
